name: Wompi Portal de Pagos
author: Wompi

sections.description:
Receive online payments by integrating the Wompi Widget and allow you to accept payments with any of the payment methods available for your business.

Third-party Service Dependency

This plugin relies on Wompi’s services to process payments. Wompi securely handles all payment NOprocesses, including transactions with credit cards, debit cards, and other local payment methods.

Services Used

  • Checkout URL: https://checkout.wompi.co
  • Production Endpoint: https://production.wompi.co/v1
  • Sandbox Endpoint (Testing): https://sandbox.wompi.co/v1
  • Transaction View: https://wompi.com/es/co/transacciones

Data Transmission

This plugin sends transaction and payment data to Wompi’s servers to securely process purchases. No sensitive customer information is stored within the plugin or on your store’s servers.

Wompi Terms and Policies

For more information on Wompi’s terms of use and privacy policies, please refer to the following links:

  • Terms of Service: [https://wompi.com/es/co/reglamento-comercios/)
  • Privacy Policy: [https://wompi.com/es/co/politica-de-privacidad?_gl=1*cejk3m*_gcl_au*MTYwMTA2NjY4OS4xNzI0MjUyNjUy&_ga=2.182332071.100676200.1728340794-564023975.1715218764)

Features

  • You can be part of Wompi as an individual or company, regardless of the size of your business and your technological capacity: our gateway helps increase sales of ventures, startups and big brands!
  • At Wompi you find the main means of electronic payment on the market: debit cards, credit cards, transfers and cash. In addition, we offer you three own payment methods: Bancolombia Button, Nequi and Bancolombia Banking Correspondents.
  • You can integrate these payment methods to websites, mobile applications, social networks, WhatsApp and in physical stores.
  • Integrate the Wompi Widget and allow you to accept payments with any of the payment methods available for your business.
  • Free to use – Open-source GPL-3.0 license on GitHub

Getting Started

  • Installation Instructions
  • Frequently Asked Questions
sections.installation: The documentation on how to install the plugin with the Wompi payment gateway is found at the following url https://docs.wompi.co/docs/colombia/woocommerce-wordpress-plugin/ In addition, requirements, functionalities and its license are detailed here
sections.faq:
How can I configure the plugin settings?

On the WooCommerce > Plugins > Wompi para WooCommerce > Configuration The Enable Wompi option must be selected. Additionally, you must have the following keys on hand: Test public key, Test private key, Test event private key, Test integrity key, Live public key, Live private key, Live event private key, Live Integrity Key. Which must be entered in their respective fields.

Where can I get my business configuration data?

To use Wompi you need a pair of authentication keys associated with your business. You can read all the information regarding authentication keys and execution environments at the following link https://docs.wompi.co/docs/colombia/ambientes-y-llaves/
If you still don’t have these keys, register at comercials.wompi.co and get your pair of Wompi keys, so you can start integrating your business.

What store configurations are supported?

Wompi currently supports transactions in CO (Colombian Pesos) and USD (US Dollar).

What are the states that a transaction can have?

The status of a transaction represents where it is in the payment process. The status allows you to know if the transaction is still in process (PENDING state) or if it has already reached a final state.
The final state of a transaction is one of the following:
APPROVED: Transaction approved. DECLINED: Transaction rejected. VOIDED: Canceled transaction (only applies to card transactions). ERROR: Internal error of the respective payment method.

How can I contribute to the plugin?

If you’re a developer and you have some ideas to improve the plugin or to solve a bug, feel free to raise an issue or submit a pull request in the Github repository for the plugin.

You can also contribute to the plugin by translating it. Simply visit translate.wordpress.org to get started.
